fields.sql_query: SELECT dfe.id AS sample_id, dfe.sample_text_id, dfe.created_at, dfe.updated_at, dfe.status AS status, analyst.id AS analyst_id, analyst.name AS analyst_name, analyst.signature AS analyst_sign, approver.id AS approver_id, approver.name AS approved_by, approver.signature AS approver_sign, authorizer.id AS auth_id, authorizer.name AS auth_by, authorizer.signature AS auth_sign, p.version AS version, p.document_code AS doc_code, CASE WHEN dfe.status = 'release' THEN 'All results are satisfactory and comply with specifications, no investigations were open.' WHEN dfe.status = 'rejected' THEN CONCAT('All results are NOT satisfactory and comply with specifications, refer to investigation: ', inv.id) ELSE '' END AS status_result, p.name AS product, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dfe.data, '$."Batch Number"')) AS batch_number, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dfe.data, '$."Type of Sample"')) AS type_of_sample, CONCAT('COA-', CAST(dfe.id AS CHAR)) AS coa_number, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dfe.data, '$."ATR Number"')) AS atr_number, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dfe.data, '$."Pre-Approval by"')) AS pre_approval_by, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dfe.data, '$."Manufacturing Date"')) AS manufacturing_date, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dfe.data, '$."Expiry Date"')) AS expiry_date, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dfe.data, '$."Specification Number"')) AS specification_number, a.id AS analysis_id, a.name AS analysis_name, tm.id AS test_method_id, tm.name AS test_method_name, sc.id AS sample_component_id, COALESCE(sc.name, c.name) AS component_name, cr.value, cr.numeric_value, cr.remarks, CASE WHEN cr.numeric_value IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(cr.numeric_value AS CHAR) ELSE cr.value END AS result_combined, sc.unit_id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, u.symbol AS unit_symbol, sc.minimum AS min_value, sc.maximum AS max_value, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM app_sampleanalysisresult WHERE sample_id = dfe.id), dfe.created_at) AS analysis_start, (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM app_statushistory WHERE entry_id = dfe.id AND new_status = 'release') AS authorized_at, sc.acceptance_criteria AS specs FROM app_dynamicformentry dfe LEFT JOIN app_product p ON p.id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(dfe.data, '$."Product"')) AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN app_user analyst ON dfe.analyst_id = analyst.id LEFT JOIN app_statushistory auth_sh ON auth_sh.id = (SELECT sh2.id FROM app_statushistory sh2 WHERE sh2.entry_id = dfe.id AND sh2.new_status IN ('completed', 'in_progress') ORDER BY CASE WHEN sh2.new_status = 'completed' THEN 1 WHEN sh2.new_status = 'in_progress' THEN 2 END, sh2.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN app_user authorizer ON authorizer.id = auth_sh.updated_by_id LEFT JOIN app_statushistory release_sh ON release_sh.id = (SELECT sh2.id FROM app_statushistory sh2 WHERE sh2.entry_id = dfe.id AND sh2.new_status = 'release' ORDER BY sh2.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN app_user approver ON approver.id = release_sh.updated_by_id LEFT JOIN app_investigation inv ON dfe.id = inv.sample_id LEFT JOIN app_dynamicformentryanalysis dea ON dea.entry_id = dfe.id LEFT JOIN app_analysis a ON a.id = dea.analysis_id LEFT JOIN app_sampleanalysisresult sar ON sar.sample_id = dfe.id LEFT JOIN app_testmethod tm ON tm.id = a.test_method_id LEFT JOIN app_samplecomponent sc ON sc.entry_analysis_id = dea.id LEFT JOIN app_component c ON c.id = sc.component_id LEFT JOIN app_unit u ON u.id = sc.unit_id LEFT JOIN app_componentresult cr ON cr.sample_component_id = sc.id AND cr.entry_id = dfe.id LEFT JOIN app_statushistory sh ON sh.entry_id = dfe.id AND sh.new_status = dfe.status WHERE dfe.id = %(sample_id)s ORDER BY a.name, component_name;
